nodes.title: Commission holds special meeting of Scientific panel on frontier AI safety and risks
nodes.tldr: Commission holds special meeting of Scientific panel on frontier AI safety and risks Anonymous (not verified) Fri, 10/09/2026 - 09:16 Today, the Commission holds a special meeting ...
nodes.details: Commission holds special meeting of Scientific panel on frontier AI safety and risks Anonymous (not verified) Fri, 10/09/2026 - 09:16 Today, the Commission holds a special meeting of the Scientific Panel on artificial intelligence (AI). The panel has been investigating recent loss-of-control incidents, and together with the Commission’s AI Office, has worked on a set of questions for the companies that developed the models involved. Henna Virkkunen, Executive Vice-President for Tech Sovereignty, Security and Democracy, will attend the meeting. The Scientific Panel brings together 60 world-leading independent experts who advise the EU AI Office and national authorities on systemic risks, model classification, evaluation methodologies, and cross-border market surveillance. During the meeting, the panel will present recommendations to the Commission on frontier AI safety and security risks. Executive-Vice President Henna Virkkunen said: “The EU has the first law in the world that addresses systemic risk from AI, and we need state-of-the-art scientific input. AI capabilities are advancing rapidly, but with a strong legal framework, decisive enforcement and the best scientific minds supporting this work, Europe can lead in ensuring safe and secure AI.” Find out more about the Scientific Panel on artificial intelligence (AI) Related topics Artificial intelligence AI Office Scientific panel

nodes.title: Establishing the European AI Observatory: Call for tenders
nodes.tldr: Establishing the European AI Observatory: Call for tenders Anonymous (not verified) Mon, 10/05/2026 - 09:22   Opening: 05 October 2026   Closing: 03 November 2026 The Com...
nodes.details: Establishing the European AI Observatory: Call for tenders Anonymous (not verified) Mon, 10/05/2026 - 09:22   Opening: 05 October 2026   Closing: 03 November 2026 The Commission is seeking a procurement contract for the setup and operation of the AI Observatory for a period of three years. The European AI Observatory is a new initiative to monitor and boost the uptake of AI in key sectors across the EU. It will support the objectives of the Apply AI Strategy. The project will provide indicators to assess the impact of AI in strategic sectors. It will also monitor AI development and changes it may bring to the labour market and the economy overall, as well as support the organisation of sectorial discussions. The successful contractor will: Develop a robust monitoring framework focusing on a set of key performance indicators to track the sectoral uptake of AI. The framework should help to understand related key domains – including AI investments, AI-related patents, skills and talents, and computing infrastructure – and monitor their impact on the EU economy and society. Prepare a set of sector-specific qualitative monitoring reports identifying and assessing AI use cases accross core processes of strategic sectors. Prepare a set of reports on cross-cutting challenges identified in the Apply AI Strategy and beyond. Develop and manage the AI Observatory’s website. The website should display – in an interactive and appealing way – key performance indicators, strategic sector overview fiches, a tracker of the policy actions of the Commission on AI, a selection of reports on AI, as well as links to the national AI strategies of EU countries. Learn more about this tender and apply through the EU Funding & Tenders Portal. Related topics Artificial intelligence
